{{Quote|Cody says that General Kenobi never reached the landing site. They think his gunship got shot down.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] on the destruction of the ''Bad Kitty''|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
The '''''Bad Kitty''''' was an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The ''Bad Kitty'' had customized nose art painted on either of its sides, with a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] riding a large bomb and the ship's name written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on the bomb. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] saw action during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]&mdash;when the Republic [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|attacked]] the Separatist [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]&mdash;serving as a troop transport during a Republic assault on a [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|Geonosian foundry]]. However, while the ''Bad Kitty'' was carrying [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to a Republic staging area, the gunship was shot down by Separatist [[Flak gun/Legends|flak guns]]. The resulting crash-landing [[Death/Legends|killed]] everyone onboard except for Kenobi and a trooper nicknamed [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]], and the Separatist ground forces soon started to attack the downed gunship, leaving the two survivors trapped inside. As the Separatists neared the ''Bad Kitty'', two clone troopers, nicknamed [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]], managed to reach the gunship, pull the survivors out of the ''Kitty''{{'s}} wreckage, and carry them back the Republic's staging area. The gunship was later recovered and repaired after the battle.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|General Kenobi, don't land! The zone is hot!''"<br />"''But there's nowhere else to go!|Cody and Kenobi right before the ''Bad Kitty'' is shot down|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
[[File:Bad_Kitty_noseart.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Bad Kitty''{{'s}} nose art]]
The ''Bad Kitty'' was a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="LaPR" /> Manufactured by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]],<ref name="CCS" /> the ''Kitty'' had customized nose art painted on both sides, depicting of a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] riding a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] with the gunship's name written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on the bomb.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> The ''Bad Kitty'' had a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] large enough to hold a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]], a pair of anti-personnel [[Laser/Legends|laser]] turrets at the front of the vessel, two [[Engine/Legends|engines]], and four [[composite-beam laser]] turrets, two of which were at either side of the ''Kitty'' and the other two built-into both of the gunship's wings. The ''Kitty'' had a passenger compartment in its center that was large enough to hold several grown [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Although the ''Bad Kitty'' was well armored, it could not withstand sustained enemy fire.<ref name="LaPR" />

==History==
{{Quote|We're hit! We're going down!|General Kenobi to Commander Cody|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> the Confederacy reactivated their [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|battle droid foundries]] on the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], which the Republic had previously deactivated at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start of the war]]. In response, the Republic launched a [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|full scale assault]] on Geonosis, sending a large Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]&mdash;including the ''Bad Kitty''&mdash;to conquer Geonosis and deactivate the factories. The Republic task force planned to launch a large, three-pronged aerial attack against the Separatists' well defended [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary factory]], protected by a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. In the assault, the ''Bad Kitty'' would transport [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;who would lead the Republic's northern push&mdash;and several [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], including a trooper nicknamed [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]].<ref name="LaPR" />

[[File:Obi_Trapper.png|thumb|right|250px|Obi-Wan and Trapper in the ''Kitty''{{'s}} wreckage]]
During the battle, Kenobi and his troopers boarded the gunship, and the ''Kitty'' departed from a Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Star Destroyer]] it had been stationed at, being one of the first gunships to launch. As the ''Kitty'' and the rest of Kenobi's gunships approached the Separatist perimeter line, they were met by a well prepared Confederate defense, including [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton]] and [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|sonic cannons]]. Several of the Republic's gunships were destroyed by the Separatist [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air fire]], although the ''Kitty'' managed to evade the enemy's shot. However, as the ''Kitty'' neared the Republic's planned landing point&mdash;designated Point Rain&mdash;several [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian starfighters]] attacked the gunship, damaging its left engine, forcing the ''Bad Kitty'' into a crash-landing. The Republic vessel skidded across the desert ground, snapping off its left wing and [[Death/Legends|killing]] everyone on board except [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi and Trapper.<ref name="LaPR" />

The downed gunship settled five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away from the Republic's landing point, near the Separatists' defense lines, leaving Kenobi and Trapper trapped in the ''Kitty''{{'s}} wreckage. Meanwhile, the remainder of Kenobi's forces managed to arrive at Point Rain and set up a defense square around the landing point. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], who had taken command at the square, saw the downed gunship and, believing it to be the ''Bad Kitty'', sent a pair of Advanced Recon troopers nicknamed [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] to rescue any survivors. With the defense square giving covering fire, Waxer and Boil ran the five-kilometer distance, barely dodging Separatist [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] fire. The two recon troopers were able to reach the downed ''Kitty'' and pry off its right troop compartment door. Seeing the badly injured Kenobi and Trapper, Waxer and Boil helped the two out of the gunship's wreckage and walked the survivors back to the square, supporting Kenobi and Trapper with their shoulders. After getting back to the landing point, Kenobi and Trapper were given medical support.<ref name="LaPR" />

Sometime after the conclusion of the battle, the ''Kitty'' was recovered by the Republic and subsequently repaired. It was later seen stationed in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by the time of the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission to rescue Even Piell]].

==Crew==
The ''Bad Kitty'' was flown by a clone [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and had a clone copilot who operated the ship's wing particle beam turrets. The ''Kitty'' also had a pair of [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone gunners]] that operated both of vessel's side beam turrets. During the assault on Geonosis, the ''Bad Kitty'' transported several clone troopers, including a trooper nicknamed Trapper, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Obi-Wan Kenobi. After the gunship was shot down, all of the ''Kitty''{{'s}} passengers were killed, with the exception of Kenobi and Trapper, who were rescued by Waxer and Boil soon after.<ref name="LaPR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BadKittyImpostor-LaPR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The other ''Bad Kitty'']]
''Bad Kitty'' made its first appearance in "[[Landing at Point Rain]]," the fifth episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. In the episode, the gunship had its nexu nose art put in as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|easter egg]], as "Bad Kitty" was the nickname the [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] animation team gave the nexu in the [[Petranaki arena]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="EpGuide" />

In "Landing at Point Rain," a gunship with identical nose markings can be seen dropping off Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] after the shield generator is destroyed. As the ''Bad Kitty'' was clearly not flight-worthy after crashing, with one of its wings having been snapped off, it is unclear if this was meant to be a sister gunship with identical markings, if ''Bad Kitty'' was somehow repaired and put back into action in that short period of time, or if the episode's design team made an error in using the ''Kitty''{{'s}} modeling skin later in the episode.
